title: 2-layer DC coupon (front and back probed)

assumptions: a leaky tent over a 0.5 mm via lets ENIG nickel into the barrel (read on the microsection); tents are 'not guaranteed' by OSH Park

drill convention: the drill file's via sizes are finished holes (the fabs' standard; FAB_NOTES asks for them as drawn), but pdnsim's barrel (either via model) reads the board's drill as the drilled outer-barrel diameter (A = π·t·(d − t), docs/PHYSICS.md §3). If the hole is finished as drawn, the real barrel resistance differs from prediction (a)'s by 0.30 mm -15.6 %, 0.50 mm -9.7 % (−2t/(d + t) at 25.4 µm); (a) via errors of that size are this convention, not the via model; (b) uses the microsection's wall and finished hole and is immune

ENIG on every mask-free pad (nickel 3–6 µm, IPC-4552): the board thickness is read with a micrometer contact ≤ 2.5 mm centred on each 3 × 3 mm thickness island (docs/CORRELATION.md §3), so the reading includes the finish of both faces (+6–12 µm, ≤ 0.8 % of the span; not subtracted); a flat 6.35–8 mm anvil would also rest on the mask-covered pour and the silkscreen around the island (+10–80 µm, 0.6–5 %) and is not a valid reading; the vias are tented, so no finish in the measured barrels
notes: the same artwork as DC-A@JLCPCB; OSH Park prints no serial: write it in the S/N square
